title: Indo-Portuguese creoles - Wikipedia
text: Indo-Portuguese creoles are the several Portuguese creoles spoken in the former settlements of Portuguese India, including those in Kerala, Bombay, Korlai, Bassein, Goa, Daman and Diu, the Bengal Delta, Portuguese Ceylon, etc; in present-day India and Sri Lanka.

title: Portuguese-based creole languages - Wikipedia
text: Portuguese creoles (Portuguese: crioulo) are creole languages which have Portuguese as their substantial lexifier. The most widely-spoken creoles influenced by Portuguese are Cape Verdean Creole, Guinea-Bissau Creole and Papiamento. Origins.
